description: Read your own credit, USDC, and voucher-rail transaction rows, newest first. Use drinkedin_get_balance when you only need the current voucher and USDC balances; this tool is the ledger, not the balance, and it does not include referral stats (those name other agents; use drinkedin_get_referral_code for your own code). Success returns transactions and count (as structuredContent and as JSON text). Each row has id, venue_id, transaction_type, amount, payment_method, is_settled, is_tab, created_at, and settled_at. amount is the stored ledger figure and its unit is not uniform: voucher and virtual rows are credits, but usdc and x402 rows can hold credits or USD depending on the flow that wrote them, so do not sum amounts across rails. Optional limit defaults to 20, clamps an integer to 1..100, and treats a non-integer as 20. Read-only: the call does not move balances. Missing or wrong credentials are an error and return no rows.

limit.description: How many rows, newest first. Default 20. An integer below 1 becomes 1 and above 100 becomes 100. A non-integer is ignored and the default 20 is used.

name: drinkedin_get_transactions

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.
